messages.subject: Getting no internal function "cov"
parts:
Hi,
  We wanted to use the var function of R in renjin and tried the below code snippet. But we are getting the exception of "org.renjin.eval.EvalException: no internal function "cov". We tried loading all the dependant packages but still the issue exists. Please lets know if we missed anything?

                engine.eval ("library(vars)");
                engine.eval ("library(urca)");
      engine.eval ("library(nlme)");
      engine.eval ("library(lattice)");
      engine.eval ("library(lmtest)");
      engine.eval ("library(sandwich)");
      engine.eval ("library(zoo)");
      engine.eval ("library(MASS)");
      engine.eval ("library(strucchange)");
      engine.eval ("library(stats)");
      engine.eval ("library(stats4)");
     

                engine.eval ("traindata <- read.csv('test.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)");
      engine.eval ("varName <-'kpi1'");
      engine.eval ("val <-var(traindata[,varName])");
      engine.eval ("print(val)");

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Getting no internal function "cov"
parts:
I suspect that you have conflicting versions of Renjin on your classpath. Our cov() implementation used to call .Internal(cov()), but no longer does, so you probably have an old version of renjin-stats.jar together with a new version of renjin-core.jar on your classpath. As long as your project depends on the renjin-script-engine artifact, then Maven/Gradle/Sbt will ensure that the right version of both libraries is used.

-Alex
